The Chinese characters for Julia

As a transliteration, Julia is usually written 朱莉娅 (Zhū lì yà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

朱
Zhū
vermilion
莉
lì
jasmine
娅
yà
aunt by marriage (in names)

Origin and meaning

Julia comes from Latin and means “youthful”.

About the name Julia

A Roman family name, and the name of the chef Julia Child.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Julia suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
